mapper.select: SELECT u.users_idx AS usersIdx, u.user_name AS userName, c.company_num AS companyNum, ce.cert_status AS certStatus FROM users u JOIN company c ON u.users_idx = c.users_idx LEFT JOIN cert ce ON u.users_idx = ce.users_idx WHERE u.user_type = 'COMPANY'
select u.user_name, c.company_num, c.phone, c.address, u.login_id, u.password, c.email from users u join company c on u.users_idx = c.users_idx where u.users_idx = #{userIdx}
